endpoints.summary: Liveness probe (includes a DB ping)
The caller's current organization (org-scoped)
List ledger books in the caller's organization
Create a ledger book (账套) — admin/supervisor only
List invitations (admin/supervisor)
Invite a user by email with a role (admin/supervisor)
Accept an invitation (authenticated invitee — not yet a member)
Revoke a pending invitation (admin/supervisor)
List organization members (admin/supervisor)
List task-kernel work items (org-scoped; ledger scope applies when present)
Work item detail with backend-computed actions
Execute a backend-authorized work item action
List chart of accounts (ledger-scoped, code order = tree pre-order)
Create an account (accountant/admin)
Seed the 《小企业准则》 standard chart (idempotent)
Update an account's name / aux types (accountant/admin)
Deactivate an account (blocked if it has active children)
List journal vouchers (ledger-scoped; optional status filter)
Create a draft voucher (accountant/cashier)
Voucher detail (with lines)
Replace a draft voucher's header + lines (only while draft)
Submit a draft for review (draft → pending); enforces 借贷必平
Post a pending voucher (pending → posted; SoD — maker ≠ poster)
Reverse a posted voucher (红冲) — creates a posted reversal voucher
List capture intakes (ledger-scoped; optional status filter)
Capture an economic event (photo/pdf/text) for extraction → voucher draft
Intake detail (includes extraction; ERP-only, never sent to My-Chat)
Run extraction on a received intake (received → extracted)
Build a voucher draft from an extracted intake (extracted → drafted)
Discard an intake (→ discarded); any draft voucher remains a draft
Trial balance (试算平衡表) — derived from posted vouchers
Subsidiary ledger (明细分类账) for one account — derived, running balance
List period-close records (会计期间结账状态)
Close-readiness for a period (未过账 / 前期未结账)
期末结账 — 结转损益 + lock the period
反结账 — 红冲 the 结转 voucher + reopen
List 现金流量项目
Seed the 《小企业准则》 CF items + chart defaults (idempotent)
Pre-close worklist — untagged non-cash lines of cash vouchers
CF tie-out — tagged flows == net cash change over a range
Post-hoc 打标 — set 现金流量项目 on a voucher's non-cash line(s) (pre-close worklist)
资产负债表 (as-of date)
利润表 (range — 月/季/年/自定义)
现金流量表 (direct method, range)
List 出纳收付款单 (PaymentDoc)
Create a 收/付款单 draft
Get a payment doc
draft → pending_approval (opens the approver task)
pending_approval → approved (SoD; opens the cashier task)
approved → confirmed — generate + post the settlement voucher
作废 a pre-confirmed payment doc
List 合同 (Contract)
Create a 合同 (code auto-assigned HT-{fiscalYear}-{NNN})
Get a contract
Update a contract (status / fields; version-guarded)
合同时间线 — contract event ∪ linked vouchers ∪ payments (time-ordered)
Opening balances (期初余额) + the ledger's enabled period
Set the enabled period + replace opening balances (期初建账)
